objective_convention: Q = gross_operational_cost, settlement EXCLUDED; TSO block costs block-weighted EUR

sign_unit_check_phase_A.meaning: the price-taker DN-side p_mw and LL E_dso_pu x B_dn share sign convention and unit iff the recomputed max equals the stage-recorded one

stage: P5.15 W124 -- records-only block energy / curtailment check of the NRF benchmark mechanism (zero solves, no model loads)

summary.aggregation: plain = sum over the 12 representative days (MWh); day_weighted = x PT curtailment per_block[TSO|-|b].day_weight (undiscounted days represented)

coordinated_tn_curtailment_context.note: totals only; the coordinated per-block TN curtailment is not in the records read here

verdict_rule.H1: energies agree AND C_pt > 0 AND pi_min <= dTSO / C_pt <= pi_max
verdict_rule.energy_agree: |E_pt - E_co| / E_co <= 0.01 (reading R_total, PRIMARY: three-node total; reading R_node: every node)
verdict_rule.outside_rule: energies agree, ratio defined, ratio outside [pi_min, pi_max] -- not named by the Planner rule
verdict_rule.undetermined: energies agree but the ratio is undefined (a TSO-cost / curtailment record missing, or C_pt <= 0)
